path_convention: Every packaged file path is relative to the CREMA project root. Generation workspace locations and private output paths are intentionally not recorded.

generation_tool.name: image_gen
generation_tool.model_version_note: The generation tool did not expose a model-version identifier. No model version is asserted.

scope: An authored visual interpretation of pressure-driven espresso extraction. Generated imagery is not photography of an actual machine or experiment, measured physical data, engineering CAD, micro-CT or CFD output. No specific manufacturer or brand provenance is asserted.

inventory.note: The one prebuilt dist contains runtime copies, not an additional set of source images. Optional procedural model snapshots are recorded in their separate model manifest.

selection_notes: The discarded hero-a study used conventional left-copy/right-product placement and read too close to a product advertisement. The selected hero-b instead placed a monumental radial machine above architectural typography. The rejected image and its failed asset file are not included.
The accepted portrait study informed the mobile crop and scale. Its handwritten/serif-like secondary type was intentionally not followed; the implemented interface uses Archivo throughout.
Concept images contain baked example typography and controls only as art-direction references. Interface text, navigation and interactions are implemented in HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
Prompt-requested dimensions are creative directions. The dimensions_px fields report the actual retained image sizes.
Production round order is recorded; exact generation times and within-round wall-clock order were not recorded.

production_chronology.label: 01 — Initial comparison
production_chronology.summary: Two hero directions and the first particle-bed composition were generated. The radial hero and bed study were retained.

production_chronology.label: 02 — Shared scene language
production_chronology.summary: Saturation, porous flow, crema and the final cup established the material and composition language across the journey.

production_chronology.label: 03 — Production refinement and missing moments
production_chronology.summary: The selected radial hero was regenerated as a clean production master. Dedicated pressure, first-drop and portrait composition studies completed the accepted visual bible.

production_chronology.label: 04 — Production asset refinement
production_chronology.summary: Selected crema, cup and bed studies were regenerated as clean production masters. A new frame-filling granule texture completed the five production images.

processing_policy.generation_edits: Reference-based image changes, including removing typography, clearing the machine backdrop, removing the static hero droplet and refining material detail, were performed through image_gen using the exact prompts below.
processing_policy.outside_generation_tool: Only format/quality conversion from PNG to WebP was applied to the retained raster images outside image_gen: ffmpeg, quality 90, compression level 6; no crop, resize or external retouch.
processing_policy.runtime: The website independently composes live typography, responsive framing, particle geometry, wetting, pressure interpretation, porous flow, extraction colour, droplet tension, stream and crema evolution. These are authored visual systems, not edits to the archived production images.

generations.purpose: Selected radial machine hero composition; visual reference for the machine production master and live DOM composition.
generations.prompt_exact: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a single extremely polished full-viewport 16:9 desktop website art-direction keyframe for CREMA, an immersive digital artwork on pressure-driven espresso extraction. This is one of seven coordinated full-screen chapters (machine, particles/bed, saturation, pressure/percolation, extraction/drop, crema, cup). Visual world: optical inspection chamber, near black graphite #101211, cold chrome versus very restrained warm coffee amber, precise Swiss grotesk typography (Archivo-like), generous negative space, no cafes, lifestyle, beans, latte art, generic brown gradients, neon, cards, gauges, dashboard HUD, eyebrow above heading, browser frame. Navigation and text are intended to be reconstructed in DOM; all material objects are fully rendered photographic assets. Standard small header: top left wordmark CREMA; top right two quiet controls “Index” and “Sound off”. Footer quiet chapter number left and a very thin journey rule. Flat full-bleed composition, not a picture inside a rounded panel. Typography and object must feel precisely composed together, cinematic editorial scale. HERO B exploratory alternative composition. Wide 1536x864. A monumental unbranded polished steel bottomless espresso group head dominates the UPPER center of a symmetrical dark chamber, massive circular radial geometry underside, black rubber, silver concentric machining, very precise perforated filter basket. A TINY amber droplet suspended at x50% y55%, never a stream. No cup. Below group head, gigantic wide white word CREMA spread across almost whole canvas at y65-84%. Small text in left midground 'Before the first drop.' and a short underline link 'Enter the extraction ↓'. Very spare, bold industrial typography; text and chrome partially overlap with machine masking foreground. Footer '01 — MACHINE'. No nine bar text. Compare severe radial monumental composition to editorial asymmetric alternative. Genuine cold polished silver.

generations.prompt_exact: Use case: precise-object-edit. This reference is the chosen CREMA web hero concept. Produce the standalone production photographic background asset from it, same exact 16:9 framing, lighting and cold steel rendering. REMOVE ALL TEXT, logos, UI labels, white letters, timeline, numbers. Remove the entire small amber coffee droplet and amber highlight from center of filter, make the basket underside clean cool metal, because a physically animated droplet will be rendered there in code. Remove the visible drip tray/floor and distant machine support rods in lower 50%, replace with continuous near-black #090b0a empty space. Preserve the top group head's strong polished cold silver concentric radial geometry and hundreds of fine basket holes, attached stem cropped off the top edge. Add genuine fine machining marks. DO NOT turn the espresso head into a shower head. At x50% y40-43% is the filter center, bottommost metal is at about y47%. Object centered upper half, huge, no object in lower half. No text of any kind, no drop, no cup, no branding, no extra items. This is a high quality photographic render of a made-up generic espresso machine, not specific manufacturer. Render the whole screen with original dark negative space.

generations.prompt_exact: Use case: ui-mockup. Create single widescreen 16:9 optical-inspection art website CREMA, same cold-steel/dark-coffee visual world and Archivo-like Swiss sans typography. Screen is an extremely quiet pressure moment. Deep near-black backdrop, ghosted photographic ring of steel basket almost fills screen, elliptical rim. Inside dim rough coffee bed sits very low foreground, clear silvery water spanning its upper surface. No gauges or dashboard. At absolute center only giant off-white '9' around 400px tall, immediately adjacent smaller 'BAR' 50px, very thin type weight 400. The numeral floats in front of barely visible dark water and coffee, not surrounded by graphic instruments. Tiny but readable centered footnote below 'A classical reference. A variable profile.' One small top left brand CREMA, top right Index / Sound off. Bottom left '05 — PRESSURE' and fine bottom journey line. No other headings or fake stats. Build dense quiet tension, relief after granular complexity. Pressure is something in material and space, numeral is a single fleeting statement.

generations.purpose: Frame-filling, square cellular material image for the authored coffee-particle geometry.
generations.prompt_exact: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a SQUARE orthographic microscope MATERIAL TEXTURE of one large fractured piece of roasted coffee endosperm; closeup brown-black organic porous cellular interior, thick jagged ridges around deep irregular tiny pits, fine dry woody fractured fibers. It is completely frame filling, evenly lit from upper left, no object outline or background. Not a collection of coffee beans; no whole recognizable coffee bean shape; not geological basalt, soil, sand, or smooth rocks. Dark cocoa to burnt umber with subtle natural tonal variation. Texture should be useful as rough color/bump map on many irregular 3D coffee granules. No labels, UI, text, ruler or microscope border. Extremely detailed tactile dry cellular fragment, square 1024x1024.
